sources.q10: Median Q10 of the vegetables with derived values (no usable respiration data)
sources.sl_ref_hours: Ambient life 96-120 h at unstated temperature (taken as 25 C), converted to 25 C with Q10; https://epubs.icar.org.in/index.php/IJAgS/article/download/163339/64181/505463
sources.alpha: Median alpha of the vegetables calibrated on NABCONS 2022; no loss row for this crop
sources.second_life: Processing: dehydrated slices/rings/cubes, pickle in oil, minimally processed bitter gourd (https://cftri.res.in/technologies/FVP/dbg.pdf); Recover: biogas, compost (D19)
sources.water_l_per_kg: Mekonnen and Hoekstra 2010, Report 47, global average, row 'Pumpkins, squash and gourds (broader row)', https://www.waterfootprint.org/resources/Report47-WaterFootprintCrops-Vol1.pdf
